text: The UI Designer will design the LCD screen function menu and prepare a list of the functions to be shown on the screen/menu, covering items 0 and 1. The UI Designer will group the menu into a display group and a basic functions group, as described in item 2. There is a concern that elderly users may not understand the remote, indicating a need for a simpler remote per item 3. Teletext functionality will be skipped and the target age range is defined as sixteen to forty, while we decide on two function groups: simple for the general public and advanced for younger users (items 4, 5, 6). The LCD/TV options menu should be activated by software options, with extra advanced options on the onscreen display and the screen placed on the top, per items 7, 8, 9. Finally, there remains uncertainty about which functions to include, as noted in item 10.
